what.text: This page follows refugees from Burundi living in Malawi, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6676 Burundian refugees in Malawi, 2.1% of all refugees from Burundi.
Tanzania hosts the most Burundian refugees, followed by Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in periods from 1991 to 2024, at war level in some of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2021 to 2025, overlap the 2019 to 2024 period of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 8 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malawi.
These are year-end totals for Malawi only, reported to UNHCR.
